randomization_integrity.note: Assignment is generated independently in the synthetic fixture.

stable_assignment.note: Each synthetic randomized unit has one fixed assignment.

sample_ratio_review.note: The fixture uses balanced control and treatment opportunities.

shadow_trigger_in_both_arms.note: Eligibility is generated before assignment and shared across arms.

shadow_assignment_invariant.note: The synthetic shadow trigger does not read assignment.

shadow_pre_treatment_inputs_only.note: The synthetic shadow trigger uses only generated pre-treatment inputs.

policy_version_complete.note: The fixture has one fixed synthetic policy version.

first_shadow_trigger_positive_unique_per.note: Only the earliest synthetic shadow-trigger-positive record contributes per unit.

no_prior_experimental_exposure.note: Synthetic primary records occur before any experimental AIO exposure.

constant_assignment_propensity_for_aggre.note: The synthetic cohort uses one assignment propensity.

one_primary_contribution_per_user.note: Each synthetic user contributes one modeled outcome.

actual_delivery_not_used_for_selection.note: Actual delivery is absent from synthetic cohort selection.

outcome_mature_and_joined_once.note: All synthetic outcomes are mature and joined once.

binary_outcome_approved.note: The generated outcome is Bernoulli by construction.

opaque_id_and_feature_provenance_approve.note: IDs and token lengths are visibly synthetic and versioned.

strata_handling_approved.note: The fixture contains one declared synthetic stratum.

restricted_output_approved.note: The synthetic example may write only to its ignored build directory.
